root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.DeliveryPromiseRuleTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.DeliveryPromiseRuleTbl ( RuleID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_DeliveryPromiseRuleTbl PRIMARY KEY, RuleGroup NVARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, AreaID INT NULL, AreaMatchName NVARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, SortOrder INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DPR_Sort DEFAULT (0), WindowStartDow TINYINT NOT NULL, WindowStartMinutes SMALLINT NOT NULL, WindowEndDow TINYINT NOT NULL, WindowEndMinutes SMALLINT NOT NULL, PromiseKind NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, ResultMode NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, ResultDow TINYINT NULL, NoThursdayDispatch BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DPR_NoThu DEFAULT (0), WedAfterNoonToFriday BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DPR_WedFri DEFAULT (0), Notes NVARCHAR(255) NULL, Enabled BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_DPR_Enabled DEFAULT (1) ); CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryPromise_Area ON dbo.DeliveryPromiseRuleTbl (AreaID); CREATE INDEX IX_DeliveryPromise_Group ON dbo.DeliveryPromiseRuleTbl (RuleGroup); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.DeliveryPromiseRuleTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.AreasTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL BEGIN UPDATE r SET r.AreaID = a.AreaID FROM dbo.DeliveryPromiseRuleTbl r INNER JOIN dbo.AreasTbl a ON a.AreaName = r.AreaMatchName WHERE r.AreaID IS NULL OR r.AreaID <> a.AreaID; END
